titleEn: Basement Renovation Cost Vancouver & Metro Vancouver 2026 — Real Prices
titleZh: 溫哥華及大溫地下室裝修費用2026——真實工程造價
contentEn:
Basement renovations in Vancouver and Metro Vancouver are among the highest-ROI upgrades you can make as a homeowner. A finished basement converts dead storage space into legal living area, and in neighbourhoods like East Vancouver, Burnaby, and Coquitlam — where assessed values routinely exceed $1.2M — that new square footage adds meaningful value to your property.

What Does a Basement Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Based on Reno Stars' actual project data from 2024–2026, basement renovation costs in Metro Vancouver break down as follows:

ScopeTypical Cost (CAD)Notes
Basic suite (1 bedroom, partial finish)$35,000 – $55,000Framing, drywall, flooring, basic lighting, one bathroom rough-in
Full 2-bedroom legal suite$65,000 – $110,000Full rough-in, separate entrance, kitchenette, bathroom, separate hydro meter
High-end custom basement$120,000 – $200,000+Home theatre, wet bar, spa bathroom, radiant floor heating throughout

These are all-in costs including materials, labour, permits, and inspections. Prices vary by municipality — a City of Vancouver basement suite permit adds approximately $2,500–$4,000 in fees on top of the construction budget.

What Drives the Cost of a Basement Renovation

1. Whether you are adding a legal secondary suite. A legal suite requires separate entrance, independent hydro meter, specific ceiling heights (min. 6'8"), and fire separation from the upper floors. These requirements add $15,000–$30,000 to the project but unlock the ability to rent the suite legally and add significant assessed value.

2. Existing conditions. Basements with existing moisture issues, old cast-iron drains, or undersized footing clearances require remediation before finishing can begin. Reno Stars inspects all basement conditions before quoting — we have seen foundation walls require parging, old clay tile drains require replacement, and in rare cases, sump pump installation.

3. Ceiling height. Homes built before 1990 often have basement ceilings below today's minimum of 6'8" for habitable rooms. If yours is lower, you have two options: lower the floor (expensive, $20,000–$40,000) or excavate and underpin (rarely economic at $80,000+).

4. Plumbing distance from the main drain. The further your basement bathroom or kitchen is from the main stack, the more complex the drainage routing — and the higher the plumbing cost.

Do You Need a Permit for a Basement Renovation in Vancouver?

Yes, in most cases. Any basement renovation that involves structural changes, new plumbing, new electrical circuits, or the creation of a secondary suite requires a building permit in all Metro Vancouver municipalities. Key permit requirements:

  • Vancouver (City): Building permit required for any new bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen in a basement. A dedicated electrical panel upgrade may be required for a secondary suite.
  • Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey: Secondary suite approval requires a floor area calculation confirming the suite does not exceed 110 m² or 40% of the total habitable floor area.
  • Richmond: Secondary suites must comply with flood plain regulations if the property is in a designated flood plain area.

Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our standard project management service. We submit to the municipality, coordinate inspections, and manage any deficiency notices on your behalf.

How Long Does a Basement Renovation Take?

A standard full-basement renovation (not a full legal suite) takes 8 to 14 weeks from permit submission to final inspection:

  • Design and permit: 4–8 weeks (municipal processing time varies)
  • Demolition and remediation: 1–2 weeks
  • Framing, electrical, plumbing rough-in: 2–3 weeks
  • Insulation, drywall, painting: 2–3 weeks
  • Flooring, millwork, fixtures: 2–3 weeks
  • Final inspection and punch list: 1 week

A full legal secondary suite adds 2–4 weeks due to the separate entrance construction and additional inspections.

What Is the ROI of a Basement Renovation in Vancouver?

Based on 2025 assessed value data from BC Assessment, a finished basement in Metro Vancouver typically adds $80–$150 per square foot to assessed value, and in some East Vancouver and Burnaby neighbourhoods, the uplift is closer to $120–$200/sq ft for high-quality finishes.

For a 1,000 sq ft basement finished to mid-range standard ($75,000 construction cost), assessed value uplift of $90,000–$120,000 is typical — before rental income if the space is used as a legal suite ($1,400–$2,200/month for a 1-bedroom in Metro Vancouver as of 2026).

Planning a basement renovation in Vancouver, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey, Richmond, or North Vancouver? Get a free quote from Reno Stars. We serve all of Metro Vancouver, speak English, Mandarin, and Cantonese, and provide transparent fixed-price quotes including all permit fees.
contentZh:
溫哥華及大溫哥華地區的地下室裝修是業主可進行的最高投資回報升級之一。完成裝修的地下室將閒置的儲物空間轉化為合法居住空間，在東溫哥華、本拿比和高貴林等評估價值經常超過120萬加元的社區，新增加的建築面積可為您的房產帶來可觀的價值提升。

2026年溫哥華地下室裝修費用是多少？

根據聚星裝修2024年至2026年的實際項目數據，大溫哥華地下室裝修費用明細如下：

工程範圍典型費用（加元）說明
基本套房（一卧室，部分裝修）35,000 – 55,000框架、石膏板、地板、基本照明、一間浴室粗加工
完整兩卧室合法套房65,000 – 110,000完整粗加工、獨立入口、簡易厨房、浴室、獨立水電錶
高端定制地下室120,000 – 200,000+家庭影院、濕吧、豪華浴室、全屋輻射供暖

這些是包含材料、人工、許可證和檢驗在內的全包價格。費用因市政法規而異——溫哥華市地下室套房許可證費用約為2,500至4,000加元，另加建築預算。

哪些因素影響地下室裝修費用

1. 是否興建合法第二套間。合法套房需要獨立入口、獨立水電錶、最低6'8"的吊頂高度以及與上層的防火分隔。這些要求需額外增加15,000至30,000加元，但可解鎖合法出租套房的資格並大幅提升評估價值。

2. 現有條件。如存在潮濕問題、老舊鑄鐵排水管或基礎淨空不足等情況，需在裝修前進行修復。聚星裝修在報價前會檢查所有地下室條件——我們曾遇到需要抹灰的基礎牆、需要更換的陶土排水管，以及少數需要安裝污水泵的情況。

3. 吊頂高度。1990年前建造的房屋地下室吊頂通常低於今天宜居房間的最低要求6'8"。如果您的低於此標準，您有兩個選擇：降低地面（昂貴，20,000至40,000加元）或開挖加固（很少經濟實惠，80,000加元以上）。

4. 衛生間與主管道的距離。地下室浴室或廚房距離主管道越遠，排水管線規劃越複雜，人工費用越高。

溫哥華地下室裝修需要申請許可證嗎？

大多數情況下需要。任何涉及結構改造、新管道、新電路或建造第二套間的地下室裝修，都需要在整個大溫哥華地區申請建築許可證。主要許可證要求：

  • 溫哥華（市）：地下室新建卧室、浴室或廚房均需申請建築許可證。興建第二套間可能需要升級配電箱。
  • 本拿比、高貴林、素里：第二套間審批需要面積計算，確認套房不超過110平方米或佔宜居總面積的40%。
  • 列治文：如房產位於指定的洪泛區，第二套間須符合洪泛區法規。

聚星裝修作為標準項目管理服務的一部分，處理所有許可證申請。我們向市政當局提交申請、協調檢驗，並代表您管理任何補正通知。

地下室裝修需要多長時間？

標準全地下室裝修（非完整合法套房）從許可證提交到最終驗收通常需要8至14週：

  • 設計和許可證：4至8週（市政府處理時間各異）
  • 拆除和修復：1至2週
  • 框架、電氣、管道粗加工：2至3週
  • 隔熱、石膏板、油漆：2至3週
  • 地板、木作、固定裝置：2至3週
  • 最終驗收和整改：1週

完整合法第二套間因獨立入口施工和額外檢驗，需增加2至4週。

溫哥華地下室裝修的投資回報率是多少？

根據BC省估價署2025年的估價數據，大溫哥華完成裝修的地下室每平方英尺通常可增加80至150加元的估價，在東溫哥華和本拿比的一些社區，高品質裝修的增值更接近120至200加元/平方英尺。

以1,000平方英尺中等標準裝修的地下室為例（建築成本75,000加元），估價增值約為90,000至120,000加元——若該空間用作合法套房（2026年大溫哥華一卧室月租金約1,400至2,200加元），還未計算租金收入。

想在溫哥華、本拿比、高貴林、素里、列治文或北溫哥華規劃地下室裝修？獲取聚星裝修的免費報價。我們服務整個大溫哥華地區，提供英語、普通話和粵語服務，並提供包含所有許可證費用在內的透明固定價格報價。
